Carlson Capital Management Decreased Stake in Apple (AAPL) by $315,964 as Valuation Rose; As Ubiquiti Networks (Put) (UBNT) Valuation Rose, Goldman Sachs Group Raised by $7.87 Million Its Stake
June 5, 2018 - By Richard Conner
Goldman Sachs Group Inc increased its stake in Ubiquiti Networks Inc (Put) (UBNT) by 1158% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Goldman Sachs Group Inc bought 115,800 shares as the company’s stock rose 37.83% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 125,800 shares of the technology company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $8.66 million, up from 10,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Goldman Sachs Group Inc who had been investing in Ubiquiti Networks Inc (Put) for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $6.30B market cap company. The stock increased 0.29% or $0.25 during the last trading session, reaching $85. About 190,894 shares traded. Ubiquiti Networks, Inc. (NASDAQ:UBNT) has risen 72.77% since June 5, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 60.20% the S&P500.
Carlson Capital Management decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 20.72% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Carlson Capital Management sold 1,892 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 7,241 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $1.22 million, down from 9,133 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Carlson Capital Management who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $950.49B market cap company. The stock increased 0.81% or $1.55 during the last trading session, reaching $193.38. About 18.96 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since June 5, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500.
